messages:
ena: Opening a tiny PR to add a compact tool-calling example that demonstrates fallback parsing and a one-line JSON Schema. Need quick checks for links and SDK hints.

michael: include both a null-return case and an error case for the tool. reviewers expect both.

dina: draft flow:
```
User: 'Lookup price for sku-42'
Assistant -> call price_lookup(sku='42')
Tool returns: {"price_cents":1999, "currency":"USD"}
Assistant final: {"price_display":"$19.99"}
```

ena: will add a one-line JSON Schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"price_cents":{"type":["integer","null"]},"currency":{"type":"string"}},"required":["currency"]} and note that price_cents may be null if the tool fails.

sam: add JS + Python snippets showing prefered parse utility vs raw resp.output and avoid wording that implies the runtime enforces the schema.

docbot: docs-ci: "staging build started for PR #3310"

michael: small nit: prefer using canonical links (docs/schema-best-practices, docs/tool-fallbacks) not relative paths.

ena: will sanitize snippets and run ./scripts/sanitize-snippets.sh before push. pushing in ~20m.

docbot: docs-ci: "staging build passed (lint + linkcheck) for PR #3310"

dina: great, thanks. I'll do a quick review after merge for wording around 'guardrails'.

ena: merged and closing PR — follow-up will include expanded runbook examples. :thumbsup:
